experiments: Five single-purpose deterministic experiments: C1/C2 exact analytic baselines (inline), C5/C6 ambiguity demonstrations on pure-python softmax-regression dynamics (sandbox scripts staged via journaled write_file), C3 live documentation inspection (sandbox script, official pytorch.org). C4 (shape->candidate mappings) deliberately untested — the record classifies it as practice-based priors.

cases.name: C1 chance floors: -log(1/K) = ln(K) and constant-predictor CE = ln(K)
cases.objective: validate the baseline numbers quoted in the record's step 0 (ln2=0.693147, ln10=2.302585) and the constant p=1/K predictor floor
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import math, sys

# C1 (record plan): chance floors. -log(1/K) for K=2,10 and the CE of a
# constant p=1/K prediction must equal ln(K) exactly.
ok = True
for K in (2, 10):
    a = -math.log(1.0 / K)
    p = [1.0 / K] * K
    ce_const = -sum(math.log(pi) / K for pi in p)  # expectation over uniform labels
    expect = math.log(K)
    m1 = abs(a - expect) < 1e-12
    m2 = abs(ce_const - expect) < 1e-12
    ok = ok and m1 and m2
    print(f"C1 K={K} -log(1/K)={a:.6f} constant-predictor-CE={ce_const:.6f} ln(K)={expect:.6f} exact={m1 and m2}")
print("C1-CHANCE-FLOORS-VERIFIED" if ok else "C1-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, exact matches for K=2 and K=10

cases.name: C2 confident-correct CE approaches zero (flat-near-zero interpretation)
cases.objective: validate the analytic basis for reading a flat loss near zero as 'likely already fit'
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import math, sys

# C2 (record plan): the CE of a near-one-hot confident correct prediction
# approaches 0 — the analytic basis for reading a flat-near-zero curve as
# "likely already fit". Assert each measured CE matches -log(conf) and is
# bounded by ~the missing probability mass (1 - conf).
ok = True
for conf in (1 - 1e-3, 1 - 1e-6, 1 - 1e-9):
    eps = 1.0 - conf
    ce = -math.log(conf)
    print(f"C2 p_correct={conf} CE={ce:.9f} (1-conf={eps:.0e})")
    ok = ok and ce < 1.1 * eps and abs(ce - (-math.log(conf))) < 1e-15
ok = ok and ce < 1e-8
print("C2-CONFIDENT-CE-APPROACHES-ZERO" if ok else "C2-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

cases.name: C5 flat-curve ambiguity: three causes, value + checks disambiguate (rootCause claim)
cases.objective: demonstrate the record's core claim — the same flat shape arises from optimizer-not-stepping, broken graph, and prior-only learning; the loss VALUE (ln2 vs prior entropy) plus the cheapest checks (grad norms, param drift, majority baseline) separate them

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, A and B flat at exactly ln(2) with different check outcomes, C flat at the prior entropy
expected.failureCriteria: flat curves not reproduced or checks do not discriminate

cases.name: C6 NaN/Inf-early ambiguity: loss fault vs LR fault, checks disambiguate
cases.objective: demonstrate that a numeric loss fault (naive log(p) underflow, clean inputs) and an LR fault (explosion at lr=1e4) produce the same early-explosion shape, and the record's checks (input scan, loss audit, LR probe) separate them

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, cause-1 inf with clean inputs and finite stable-form audit, cause-2 explosion with LR probe stabilizing
expected.failureCriteria: explosions not reproduced or checks do not discriminate
